name: Crown BRLV
oneLiner: BRLV is Crown's centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, mint/redeemed 1:1 for BRL and backed mostly by Brazilian federal Treasury bonds in segregated custody.
collateral: Brazilian federal government bonds, Tesouro Selic-linked ETFs, and de minimis cash/equivalents held in legally segregated, bankruptcy-remote reserve custody through Crown's guarantor/security-agent structure
pegMechanism: KYC-gated primary-market mint and redemption at 1 BRL per BRLV through Crown; reserves are pledged to BRLV holders through a Brazilian security-agent and fiduciary-assignment structure, while secondary-market price can deviate

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: BRLV is issued by Crown; KYC-gated primary-market mint and redemption run 1:1 for BRL through the issuer, backed by Brazilian federal Treasury bonds pledged to holders via a security-agent/fiduciary-assignment structure.

controls.label: Crown issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Crown creates BRLV supply against segregated, bankruptcy-remote Brazilian Treasury bond reserves via KYC-gated primary issuance and redeems 1:1 for BRL; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

review.evidence: Crown materials describe a single issuer minting BRLV against segregated Brazilian Treasury bond reserves pledged to holders through a security-agent structure, with KYC-gated primary issuance and daily Fact Finance attestations.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer model established from project materials; on-chain token owner/minter admins on Base and Ethereum not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain token owner/minter admin on Base (0xd204...7d36) and Ethereum (0xd7ca...e2f5) before raising confidence.
